title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (May, 2025)
summary: This post announces cumulative updates released in May 2025 for Business Central versions BC26, BC25, BC24, and BC23, including platform and application build versions for both cloud and on-premises deployments. It also documents support lifecycles and end-of-life dates for multiple release waves from 2019 to 2025.
key_points: BC26 CU01 released with W1 26.1 for both cloud and on-premises environments
BC25 CU07, BC24 CU13, and BC23 CU18 also released with specific build versions
BC25 introduced flexible environment management with major updates extending from 30-60 days to 5 months and optional minor updates
Support lifecycle table shows BC26 (2025 wave 1) supported until October 13, 2026 and BC25 (2024 wave 2) until April 4, 2026
BC23 and earlier versions marked as end-of-life with specific retirement dates documented

quotes.text: Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows BC25's key improvement in update flexibility allowing organizations longer update windows and optional minor updates

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that on-premises versions follow modern lifecycle policy with ongoing support, distinguishing from fixed policy versions
